entities.summary: Han Xin was a Chinese military general and politician who served Liu Bang during the Chu–Han Contention and contributed greatly to the founding of the Han dynasty. Han Xin was named as one of the "Three prominences of the early Han dynasty", along with Zhang Liang and Xiao He.
